claims.statement: Unstructured knowledge editing extends layer and token dimensions by employing non-local block key-value storage and cause-driven optimization directly on the last token.

support.explanation: Describes how unstructured knowledge editing handles long-form content and preserves context via cause-driven optimization.
support.passage: Firstly, in the layer dimension, we propose non-local block key-value storage to replace local layer key-value storage, increasing the representation ability of key-value pairs and incorporating attention layer knowledge. Secondly, in the token dimension, we replace "term-driven optimization" with "cause-driven optimization", which edits the last token directly while preserving context, avoiding the need to locate terms and preventing the loss of context information.

actions.findings: Unstructured knowledge editing extends layer and token dimensions by employing non-local block key-value storage and cause-driven optimization directly on the last token. [source-0e7e362cf3a94ae3]
actions.limitations: Methods rely on cause-driven optimization and block key-value storage, which remain sensitive to noise in long-form unstructured content.
actions.next_questions: How can cause-driven optimization be scaled to multi-step reasoning chains without degrading context integrity?
